lines.zh: 我一步步走过来，地都在颤
lines.en: I come step by step and the ground trembles
The furnace is three times the size now

lines.zh: 我每一步都带着一股热浪
lines.en: Each step carries a wave of heat

lines.zh: 铁皮上烧出的裂缝在扩大
lines.en: The cracks burnt into my plating keep widening

lines.zh: 我从墙那边开始，一点点压过来
lines.en: I start from beyond the wall and press in

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，铁在地上留痕
lines.en: Where I walk, iron scores the ground

lines.zh: 我的重量让木板都弯了
lines.en: My weight bows the floorboards
I am slow, and I am always moving

lines.zh: 我的肩上有几根排气管
lines.en: Several exhaust stacks rise from my shoulders
I do not go around, I break through

lines.zh: 我立在那儿，像一座炉子
lines.en: I stand there like a furnace

lines.zh: 炉火的声音比刚才更响
lines.en: The furnace is louder than before

lines.zh: 铁皮烧得发红，又暗下去
lines.en: The plating glows red, then dulls

lines.zh: 这一座城的东西，都不够烧
lines.en: Nothing in this city is fuel enough

lines.zh: 我的呼吸就是往外喷热
lines.en: My breathing is just heat being expelled
I do not dodge, I stand and wait

lines.zh: 我身上的火，你隔着十步都感觉得到
lines.en: You feel the fire on me from ten paces

lines.zh: 我把手掌翻过来，掌心是通的
lines.en: I turn my palm up, and it is open through
What I want is very simple

lines.zh: 这个身体，做出来就是给人看的
lines.en: This body was built to be seen
I am holding something in

lines.zh: 我的手垂在身侧，指尖滴着铁水
lines.en: My hands hang at my sides, iron dripping from the fingertips

lines.zh: 我的影子把整面墙都遮了
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole wall
The furnace surges and dims in my chest
I stand still, and the ground is still
You stand below me, like a lump of coal

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，火照到你脸上
lines.en: I lower my head and the fire lights your face

lines.zh: 我一开口，热气就出来了
lines.en: When I speak, heat comes out

lines.zh: 你这点能耐，连我的一层皮都撬不开
lines.en: What little you have could not pry open one layer of me

lines.zh: 我这张脸，是照着那个东西做的
lines.en: This face was copied from that thing

lines.zh: 你看到我这副样子，明白了吗
lines.en: Seeing me like this, do you understand
I am in no hurry, I wait for you to come on

lines.zh: 你的影子被我的火盖住了
lines.en: My fire has swallowed your shadow

lines.zh: 这块地板在你的重量下还在，在我的就不
lines.en: This floor holds you, not me

lines.zh: 我不需要说话，你也知道我是谁
lines.en: I need no words, you know what I am

lines.zh: 你的护甲，在我这里只是一层纸
lines.en: Your armor is paper to me

lines.zh: 我抬手，铁的声音拖得很长
lines.en: I raise a hand, the iron sound long
You are thinking of running, I know
My shell has cracked

lines.zh: 我退了半步，铁在地上磨
lines.en: I step back, iron grinding on stone
The furnace dipped, then rose again
That punched through two layers
I make a very low sound
I do not need to retreat, and I did
Part of my function has failed
You have more weight than I thought
This is not enough to stop me
I have relit once
You bring it to me for burning

lines.zh: 太小了，我连火都抬不起来
lines.en: Too small, it will not even raise my fire

lines.zh: 你手上那点热量，我早看见了
lines.en: I noticed that little heat on you long ago
Move it, that is not what I want

lines.zh: 你有更好的东西，你藏着
lines.en: You have something better, you hide it
Do not put a finger near my furnace mouth

lines.zh: 你递上来的，我一口就没了
lines.en: What you offer is gone in one breath

lines.zh: 你还站着，是还留着一手
lines.en: You are still standing, so you hold something back

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，我脚下没变
lines.en: You struck my leg, my stance unchanged
That scorched your hand
A lift of my hand pushes you away

lines.zh: 别靠，我这层铁一直在烫
lines.en: Do not come close, this plating stays hot

lines.zh: 你退的时候，鞋底融了一点
lines.en: The sole of your boot melted a little

lines.zh: 我转身，把地面划出一道
lines.en: I turn and carve a line in the ground

lines.zh: 我停住了，你别以为是我让
lines.en: I stopped, do not mistake it for yielding
You were knocked back into the wall
My joints are grinding, not breaking
Only one of me gets made

lines.zh: 我的炉子没有第二个火口
lines.en: My furnace has no second mouth

lines.zh: 这件事，从来没写进我的用途里
lines.en: That was never written into my purpose
Have you had enough of this

lines.zh: 你站的这个位置，本来是空的
lines.en: The spot you occupy was empty before

lines.zh: 铁和铁之间，不需要这些
lines.en: Between iron and iron, none of this is needed

lines.zh: 我守着这座炉，别的不想了
lines.en: I keep this furnace, I think of nothing else

lines.zh: 你要是还站着，就别怪我不留手
lines.en: If you are still standing, do not blame me
I have burned for many years

lines.zh: 我伸手，那东西直接熔了
lines.en: I reach out and the thing simply melts
One squeeze and it becomes a lump
This will not last me one round
I hold it to the furnace and watch it redden
I drop it, it is dull

lines.zh: 我把它按进地上，地焦了
lines.en: I press it into the ground and the ground scorches
There is nothing for me to take
I lower my head to look a while

lines.zh: 铁水在我指缝里凝成硬块。
lines.en: Molten iron hardens between my fingers.
Take it, I do not need it
Found you, do not run
The furnace lights all the way up
You are dead center in my view
In this city, only you still stand
I turn toward you, slowly
My heat rolls out
I open the furnace doors all the way
The floor groans under me
I have your position fixed
I raise both hands
I will be a little faster this time

lines.zh: 我听到你的脚步声就足够了
lines.en: Hearing your footsteps is enough
Furnace fire burns in my chest.

lines.zh: 这里所有东西都要烧一遍
lines.en: Everything here gets burnt once

lines.zh: 我笑了，火从牙缝里出来
lines.en: I laugh, and fire comes through my teeth
Then begin, do not delay

lines.zh: 我一直跟着你，没变过方向
lines.en: I have followed you without changing course
You run faster than last time
I press in and the walls come down

lines.zh: 你在走廊尽头，那里没有门
lines.en: You are at the corridor's end, there is no door

lines.zh: 我的热量把空气烤得扭曲
lines.en: My heat warps the air

lines.zh: 你绕了三次，还是在这一片
lines.en: You circled three times and stayed in this block
I am computing where you will land
Behind you is a dead end
I advance by degrees, unhurried

lines.zh: 你把东西都丢了，好跑一些
lines.en: You dropped everything to run lighter
This door opens in one palm strike
I hear you behind the wall

lines.zh: 我的火照得整条走廊发亮
lines.en: My fire lights the whole corridor

lines.zh: 你停下来的时候，我还在走
lines.en: When you stop, I keep walking

lines.zh: 这座城的墙全是铁的，逃不掉
lines.en: Every wall here is iron, you cannot escape
Nothing but you in my sights
You are treading my ash
The heat is still rising
Tiredness is not a function I have
Last time, I count to three

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下来，地板碎了
lines.en: One palm and the floor shatters
My fist carries fire

lines.zh: 你被甩到墙上，铁都在响
lines.en: You are thrown into the wall, the iron rings

lines.zh: 这一下把你的护甲烧穿了
lines.en: That burnt through your armor
I grab you, my palm a furnace mouth
In my hand you are like a piece of iron

lines.zh: 我推你一把，你滑出去很远
lines.en: One push slides you far

lines.zh: 我的前臂横扫，走廊都抖
lines.en: My forearm sweeps and the corridor shakes

lines.zh: 这一下没打实，可热到了
lines.en: That did not land clean, and the heat found you
You retreat, and I keep pressing
I lower my head and ram with the iron horn

lines.zh: 这一下，我自己的焊缝也在响
lines.en: At that blow even my welds groaned
I have not used my full output

lines.zh: 这座炉子第一次全功率点起来
lines.en: This furnace lights at full output for the first time
I rise up from under the ground
The ground splits, fire through the cracks
I stand and the roof is pushed through
All my furnace mouths open
The walls of this city begin to heat

lines.zh: 铁水从我的关节流下来
lines.en: Molten iron runs from my joints
My shadow covers the whole street
I land and the ground sinks a block
All the metal nearby starts to ring

lines.zh: 我抬手，把最近的墙推倒
lines.en: I raise a hand and shove the nearest wall down
Fire spreads across my back

lines.zh: 我做出来，就是为了这一刻
lines.en: I was built for this moment
This stretch gets burnt clean today
I turn my head slowly this way
You should not have stayed in this city

lines.zh: 我的脚步让窗户全碎了
lines.en: My steps shatter every window

lines.zh: 我站在中央，等一个对手
lines.en: I stand at the center, waiting for an opponent
The heat wave pushes the ash far
This city belongs to me now

lines.zh: 火灌进我的炉子，我只烧得更旺
lines.en: Fire poured into my furnace and only made me burn brighter

lines.zh: 我落下去，砸穿了两层楼
lines.en: I fell and punched through two floors

lines.zh: 水浇下来，我浑身冒白汽
lines.en: Water poured on me and I steamed white

lines.zh: 炸得我一块肩甲飞了出去
lines.en: The blast tore a shoulder plate away

lines.zh: 一支箭射进我的炉口，化了
lines.en: An arrow went into my furnace and melted

lines.zh: 那股力量穿过了我的铁，麻在里面
lines.en: That force passed through the iron and numbed me inside

lines.zh: 燃料不够了，我烧不起来
lines.en: Not enough fuel, I cannot burn

lines.zh: 雷打进我的身体，我全身都亮了
lines.en: Lightning entered me and I lit up all over

lines.zh: 这里没有地心引力，我的铁身飘着
lines.en: No gravity here, my iron body drifts
